author: blu
body: Proves Earthquake. "Earthquake deals X damage to each creature without flying and each player." is authored as the EarthquakeX marker; the engine resolves it by dealing X (the mana poured in on cast) to every non-flying creature's permanent and to both players, reusing the ordinary DealDamage path. Flyers survive. The sweep is symmetric, so the AI scores it favourable only when it has fewer non-flying creatures than the opponent (like Wrath/Armageddon), and holds it otherwise. This demo checks the non-flyer target set (flyer spared), the damage to both boards and both players, the real cast path (X = spare mana, card to graveyard, caster hit too), and the score gate.
